title: Setup → Users on a managed environment: an admin can remove a pending person from the list, and the removal cancels their invitation
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer asked for. Split out of #33187 on his word in seat repo:objectstack#5's project session, 2026-11-18T16:40Z, verbatim: 「同意」. That answered the seat's proposal to close #33187, whose add, import and per-row result have shipped, and to file the remaining "remove a pending person" button as a small card of its own.

## Why

On a managed environment, an admin adds people by email before they first sign in (pending rows, #33181 / PR #33227). When an admin mistypes an address or adds the wrong person, they need to take that pending row back out, and the invitation must die with it. Otherwise a stranger keeps a live invitation to the organization. The server door exists: `remove-sso-user` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts`, about line 779, PR #34162), and the host is told through `userDeleted` (#34183). The seat's premise read at origin/main ec227fc7 found no Setup → Users action that reaches it: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` carries `add_sso_user` and `import_sso_users`, and nothing calls `remove-sso-user`.

## First step: measure reach

On a managed environment, as a platform admin, open Setup → Users and look at a pending row. Does any control (a row action or the standard delete) remove it so that the invitation is cancelled? If one already does, close this card with that reading.

## Scope, if the gap holds

- A row action on `sys_user`, visible only on a pending row on a managed environment to the same admins who see Add/Import, calling `/api/v1/auth/admin/remove-sso-user`, with a confirm dialog.
- Its labels through the regenerated translation packs. A test beside the existing managed-visibility test. A changeset.
- Generic blocks only: the existing action/confirm-dialog machinery, no new named widget.

## Done when

- Removing a pending person from Setup → Users deletes the row and cancels the invitation. A test pins the visibility: pending + managed + admin only.

## Relations

- Split from #33187 (closed with this card). Server: #33181, PR #34162, #34183. Related: #34404 (remove-sso-user writes no audit row), #35164.
- Reader: the repo:objectstack lane seat that claims it. Dedupe: `remove-sso-user` and `pending person delete invitation cancel` in issues: no open card asks for this control (#34183 is the server seam, closed).
